situations.title: 삽관 물품 준비·점검
situations.tagline: We might need to intubate soon — can you set up the airway equipment and check it?
situations.brief: 후두경, 튜브, 흡인, 약물을 포함한 삽관 물품을 준비하고 점검하세요.
keyPhrases: I'll test the laryngoscope light and check the tube cuff.
Suction is set up and working at the bedside.
I've got two tube sizes and the medications drawn up.

situations.title: RSI 약물 준비 보조
situations.tagline: Can you draw up the induction and paralytic and label them clearly for me?
situations.brief: 진정과 근이완 약물을 준비하고 라벨을 확인해 RSI를 보조하세요.
keyPhrases: I've drawn up the sedative and the paralytic in separate syringes.
Each syringe is labeled with the drug name and dose.
I'll confirm the doses with you before you push them.

situations.title: 삽관 체위·BURP 보조
situations.tagline: Help me position him and give a little BURP so I can see the cords.
situations.brief: 시야 확보를 위해 삽관 체위와 BURP 조작을 보조하세요.
keyPhrases: I'll place him in the sniffing position for the best view.
Tell me how you want the BURP pressure adjusted.
Backward, upward, rightward pressure on the cartilage now.

situations.title: 삽관 후 위치 확인 협조
situations.tagline: Tube's in — let's confirm placement, watch for color change on the capnography.
situations.brief: EtCO2, 호흡음, 흉부 X선으로 삽관 후 튜브 위치 확인을 협조하세요.
keyPhrases: We have sustained color change on capnography, confirming the airway.
Breath sounds are equal bilaterally with no gastric sounds.
I'll order the chest X-ray to check the tube depth.
goals: 삽관 후 튜브 위치를 다중 방법으로 확인한다

situations.title: 기관절개관 기본 관리
situations.tagline: Can you show me how you keep his trach clean and secured?
situations.brief: 고정, 습화, 흡인을 통해 기관절개관 기본 관리를 수행하세요.
keyPhrases: I keep the trach ties snug but with a finger's space underneath.
Humidified oxygen prevents the secretions from drying out.
I suction gently only when he needs it to clear the airway.

situations.title: 기관절개 부위 드레싱·피부
situations.tagline: The skin around his trach looks a bit moist — how do you care for that?
situations.brief: 분비물과 피부 상태를 사정하며 기관절개 부위 드레싱을 시행하세요.
keyPhrases: I clean the stoma and change the dressing to keep the skin dry.
I'm checking the skin for redness or breakdown around the site.
A moisture-wicking dressing helps prevent skin irritation.

situations.title: 예상 어려운 기도 준비
situations.tagline: His airway looks difficult — let's get the backup devices and talk through the plan.
situations.brief: 대체 장비와 계획을 소통하며 예상 어려운 기도를 준비하세요.
keyPhrases: Let's have the video laryngoscope and bougie ready.
I'll set up a supraglottic airway as a rescue option.
Let's agree on our plan A, B, and C before we start.
goals: 예상 어려운 기도에 대비한 대체 장비를 준비한다

situations.title: 삽관 전 전산소화·apneic 산소
situations.tagline: Let's preoxygenate him well and set up apneic oxygenation before we push the meds.
situations.brief: preoxygenation과 apneic 산소를 통해 삽관 전 산소화를 최적화하세요.
keyPhrases: I'll preoxygenate him for a few minutes to build a reserve.
Let's leave a nasal cannula on for apneic oxygenation.
This buys us more safe time during the intubation attempt.
goals: 삽관 전 전산소화로 산소 예비량을 확보한다
apneic 산소로 무호흡 중 산소화를 유지한다

situations.title: 삽관 전후 혈역학 붕괴 대비
situations.tagline: His pressure is already borderline — how do we keep him from crashing during intubation?
situations.brief: periintubation 저혈압에 대비해 삽관 전후 혈역학 붕괴를 예방하세요.
keyPhrases: Let's optimize his volume and have a pressor ready before we start.
Peri-intubation hypotension is common, so we prepare push-dose pressors.
I'll watch his blood pressure closely through the whole process.

situations.title: 화상·부종 기도 조기 확보 판단
situations.tagline: He's got facial burns and his voice is getting hoarse — should we secure the airway now?
situations.brief: 시급성을 인지해 화상과 부종에 따른 기도 조기 확보를 판단하세요.
keyPhrases: Airway burns can swell rapidly, so early intubation is safer.
His hoarse voice and stridor are warning signs to act now.
I'll alert the team that we should secure the airway before it closes.
goals: 화상 기도의 조기 확보 시급성을 인지한다

situations.title: 기관절개관 교체 보조
situations.tagline: This is his first trach change — can you assist and keep the obturator ready?
situations.brief: 첫 교체 안전을 확보하며 기관절개관 교체를 보조하세요.
keyPhrases: I'll have the obturator and a same-size backup trach ready.
Suction and oxygen are set up in case he desaturates.
First changes carry more risk, so we keep the airway cart close.

situations.title: 특수 튜브 관리
situations.tagline: He's got a double-lumen tube — can you help me confirm it's positioned right?
situations.brief: 이중내강 등 특수 튜브 상황에 맞춰 관리하고 위치를 확인하세요.
keyPhrases: Let's confirm the double-lumen tube depth and cuff positions.
Each lumen ventilates a different lung, so placement is critical.
I'll auscultate to verify isolation of each side.

situations.title: 기관절개 발성밸브 적용
situations.tagline: He really wants to talk — is he ready for a speaking valve yet?
situations.brief: 커프와 발성 조건을 확인하며 기관절개 발성밸브를 적용하세요.
keyPhrases: The cuff must be fully deflated before we place the speaking valve.
Let's confirm he can breathe around the tube first.
I'll monitor his breathing and remove the valve if he struggles.

situations.title: 흡인성 폐렴 예방 기도관리
situations.tagline: What are you doing to keep him from getting aspiration pneumonia?
situations.brief: 커프압과 구강간호를 통해 흡인성 폐렴을 예방하는 기도관리를 하세요.
keyPhrases: I keep the head of his bed elevated to reduce aspiration.
The cuff pressure is checked so secretions don't slip past.
Regular mouth care lowers his risk of ventilator pneumonia.
goals: 흡인성 폐렴 예방을 위한 기도관리를 시행한다

situations.title: 기도 응급 카트 숙지·소통
situations.tagline: If his airway fails, everyone needs to know their role — let's walk through the cart.
situations.brief: 팀 역할을 배분하며 기도 응급 카트를 숙지하고 소통하세요.
keyPhrases: Let's review where the rescue devices are in the airway cart.
You handle suction, I'll manage medications during an emergency.
Everyone should know their role before a crisis hits.
goals: 응급 시 팀 역할을 사전에 배분한다

situations.title: 삽관·환기 불가 CICO 위기
situations.tagline: We can't intubate and we can't ventilate — call it, we need a surgical airway now!
situations.brief: CICO 위기에서 외과적 기도 준비로 신속히 대응하세요.
keyPhrases: This is a can't-intubate, can't-oxygenate emergency.
Get the cricothyrotomy kit open and call surgery stat.
I'll keep attempting to oxygenate while we prepare the surgical airway.

situations.title: 삽관 중 저산소·서맥 급변
situations.tagline: His sats are crashing and his heart rate's dropping mid-attempt — abort and bag him!
situations.brief: 삽관 중 저산소와 서맥 급변에 산소화 구조와 소생으로 대응하세요.
keyPhrases: Stop the attempt and bag-mask ventilate him with 100 percent oxygen.
His bradycardia is from hypoxia, so oxygenation comes first.
If the heart rate stays low, we start the arrest algorithm.
goals: 삽관 중 저산소와 서맥 급변에 즉시 대응한다

situations.title: 기관절개관 우발적 탈관
situations.tagline: His trach just came out and the stoma's fresh — he can't breathe, help me!
situations.brief: 기관절개관 우발적 탈관에 응급 재삽입과 기도유지로 대응하세요.
keyPhrases: The trach is out — cover the stoma and give oxygen over the mouth and nose.
Get the same-size and a smaller trach ready for reinsertion.
Call the airway team; a fresh stoma can be hard to recannulate.
goals: 기관절개관 탈관 시 즉시 기도를 유지한다

situations.title: 기관절개 부위 대량 출혈
situations.tagline: There's blood pouring from his trach site — press here and get help, this could be a bleed-out!
situations.brief: 기관절개 부위 대량 출혈에 압박과 응급 대응으로 대처하세요.
keyPhrases: Apply firm pressure at the site and overinflate the cuff to tamponade.
This could be a tracheo-innominate fistula — call surgery emergently.
Keep his airway secured while we control the bleeding.
goals: 기관절개 부위 대량 출혈에 압박 지혈로 대응한다
응급 팀 호출과 기도유지를 동시에 수행한다

situations.title: 식도 삽관 인지·즉시 교정
situations.tagline: There's no CO2 on the capnography and his belly's rising — that tube's in the esophagus!
situations.brief: 식도 오삽관을 인지하고 즉시 교정하는 위기 대응을 하세요.
keyPhrases: No sustained capnography means the tube is not in the trachea.
Remove the tube, bag him, and reoxygenate before the next attempt.
I'll get the video laryngoscope ready for the recheck.

situations.title: 기도부종 급성 폐색 위기
situations.tagline: His airway is swelling shut fast — his breathing is barely moving air, we need to escalate now!
situations.brief: 기도부종 급성 폐색 위기에서 응급 기도확보 에스컬레이션을 하세요.
keyPhrases: His airway is obstructing from swelling and needs immediate intervention.
Give nebulized epinephrine while we call the difficult airway team.
Prepare for both intubation and a surgical airway backup.
goals: 기도부종 급성 폐색의 위기 징후를 인지한다
